title: P1 merge-safe generated lifecycle projections
rawUserRequest: 目标：执行计划，到全部完成。 我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的Contract里。可以并行，提高效率么？另外，如果遇到流程问题，要先开工单修正。不要采用临时修补方案。

declaredIntent.summary: Repair the branch-integrated generated-projection collision discovered by #659 before any claim that parallel Work Item startup is safe.

outOfScope: Modifying #659 worktree, Contract, Summary, receipt, or branch.
Creating ordinary Work Item records by bootstrap or weakening ordinary ai-start enforcement.
Editing unrelated active or archived Work Item evidence.
Merging, releasing, or deleting branches outside this Work Item lifecycle.

sources.reason: Authoritative corrective requirements and dependency on #659.
Predecessor evidence identifying branch-integrated generated projections as the collision category.
Contract schema enforcement for explicit parallel ownership declarations.
Immutable receipt binding for the declared parallel ownership boundary.
Persistent ownership and freshness enforcement for branch-integrated generated projections.

riskAssessment.reason: Concurrent Work Item branches may each produce tracked facts that are locally isolated but collide or become stale when integrated.

reasons: P1 lifecycle correction changes concurrency enforcement and branch-integrated evidence ownership.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized automatic execution, and #664 is the required corrective before resuming #659 parallel-start claims.

preReviewWarnings: This self-hosting bootstrap is limited to #664 because normal ai-start is blocked by the predecessor’s active generated-projection collision; it grants no ordinary bootstrap permission.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record intent and integration topology before code changes and before final lifecycle closure.

acceptance: Every ai-start, ai-finish, and archive generated path that can enter a branch diff is inventoried and classified as task-namespaced/non-committed or serialized through executable ownership.
A candidate concurrency boundary cannot omit a branch-integrated generated projection; unknown or shared projections fail closed before lifecycle writes, and its receipt binds the exact declaration.
Actual linked-worktree and synthetic merge-topology regression coverage proves two allowed Work Items integrate without conflicting generated projections.
Ordinary Work Items remain unable to use this bootstrap and no foreign active evidence is mutated during discovery or denial.
Lifecycle and canonical generated capability/documentation projections truthfully describe the corrected boundary.
guidelines: Keep one task, one Work Item, one dedicated branch, one worktree, and one PR.
Prefer explicit machine-validated ownership over inferred agent convention.
Preserve fail-closed behavior for unknown, shared, or stale generated projections.
Prove the result at linked-worktree and merge topology level, not only with unit assertions.
Do not mutate foreign active evidence during discovery, denial, or recovery.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Two valid disjoint Work Items in linked worktrees each generate lifecycle projections and their branches are integrated.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Both branches integrate into one shared base without a generated-projection conflict, and each generated fact remains bound to its owning Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Create real linked-worktree fixture branches, exercise the allowed boundary, merge both into a shared integration base, and assert no generated projection conflict or stale ownership.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A candidate omits, shares, or names an unknown branch-integrated generated projection.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The candidate is denied before lifecycle writes and the diagnostic names the omitted, shared, or unknown generated projection.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise omitted, shared, and unknown categories and assert fail-closed denial before lifecycle writes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Ordinary ai-start cannot rely on the #664 self-hosting bootstrap.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A normal Work Item receives no bootstrap exception and is required to provide the ordinary validated concurrency declaration.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run normal ai-start in a fixture without this corrective bootstrap and assert dedicated-boundary validation remains mandatory.

intent.problem: #659 made parallel start possible in separate worktrees, but #664 found generated current-status, task-report, archive-index, and documentation projections can still be committed by multiple branches and conflict when merged.
constraints: Retain normal ai-start fail-closed behavior for ordinary Work Items.
Treat generated evidence as branch-integrated facts, not merely local files.
intent.rationale: Correcting the ownership model before enabling parallelism prevents hidden merge-time corruption or stale evidence from entering the release path.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized automatic execution for every Work Item in this governed corrective plan; this approval is limited to the scoped Makefile forwarding change.

rollbackNote: Use a new governed corrective to revert this Work Item and restore the prior serialization policy if merge-topology evidence demonstrates a safety regression.
